verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Namecheap's own RDAP record for namecheap.com, which shows secureDNS with delegationSigned and zoneSigned set to true and DS data (keyTag 38713) published at the registry. That indirectly suggests the registrar can carry DS records, but nothing documents a customer-facing one-click or API-driven DNSSEC signing workflow. Missing for 10: documentation of one-click DNSSEC enablement for customer domains, API or SDK/Terraform endpoints for DNSSEC/DS management, automated DS submission for customer zones, and hands-on corroboration.
